study_identification_part.si_4_title: Characterizing the distinct imaging phenotypes, clinical behavior, and genetic vulnerability of brain maturational subtypes in mood disorders

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Quantile regression was used to create normative curves for regional GMV as a function of age and sex, generating percentile predictions (5th, 50th, 95th percentiles) to calculate individual deviation z-scores.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: Quantile regression was used to obtain a normative range of regional GMV variation as a function of age and sex descripted in a previous study (Lv et al., 2021). We positioned individuals with MDD and BD on the normative percentile charts based on HC and expressed three kinds of continuous measurement of deviation from the generated normative range including the 5th percentile (z5) quantile regression predictor, the 50th percentile (z50) quantile regression predictor and the 95th percentile (z95) quantile regression predictor, as individual deviation z-scores for each brain region
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Zheng2024.pdf.md: Methods and materials / GMV normative deviation calculation and subtypes clustering

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Regional gray matter volume (GMV) extracted from 68 cortical regions using the Desikan-Killiany (DK) parcellation atlas. GMV was obtained through VBM processing with CAT12 toolbox.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: We applied regional gray matter volumes (GMV) and quantile normative modeling to create maturation curves, and then calculated individual deviations to identify subtypes within the patients using hierarchical clustering.

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age and sex were used as explanatory variables in the quantile regression normative model to predict regional GMV.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: Quantile regression was used to obtain a normative range of regional GMV variation as a function of age and sex
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.location: Zheng2024.pdf.md: Methods and materials / GMV normative deviation calculation and subtypes clustering
